narrative.overview: A warm paper interface frames a supplied regional map and a focused trip-planning sequence. Navy establishes structure, coral marks the destination and forward actions, and teal supports links and status. Three exclusive panels keep map selection, manual setup, and price review distinct.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, navy structure, coral actions, and teal supporting accents.
Self-hosted DM Sans body and Manrope bold headings and amounts.
A full image map with approximate interactive ramp overlays.
Separate route selection and price review surfaces.

rules.name: The Qualified Status Rule
rules.body: Pair every coverage or freshness condition with explicit readable text.

rules.name: The Price Truth Rule
rules.body: Give full totals and incomplete or unavailable states distinct text; a known subtotal never masquerades as the complete amount.

rules.name: The Local Elevation Rule
rules.body: Reserve shadows for floating search results and map controls.

dos: Do preserve exclusive task panels and labeled native route controls.
Do pair every amount with source, freshness, and completeness context.
Do preserve supplied-map provenance and approximate-position language.
Do keep keyboard focus and non-touch map controls available.
donts: Don't present historical image annotations as current road status.
Don't present image-calibrated dots as surveyed navigation coordinates.
Don't show a known subtotal as a complete trip price.
Don't claim browser visual or device gesture verification from source inspection.
